title: Hiking 04 - interleaved decisions, sarcasm, misquotes, a retraction, a returning member
nicknames: J and JD = Jordan; Al = Alex

messages.text: Team. November hiking trip. Let's actually decide this week. Destination, dates, budget.
Patagonia. Torres del Paine. I've been saying it for two years.
Dolomites, hut to hut. Rifugio dinners, mountains, done.
I'm good with either honestly, just tell me where to show up.
Either is fine if it's not crazy expensive.
I'm flexible on almost everything, but I'd love a proper hut-to-hut trip. Never done one.
Dates: Nov 14 to 21?
Yes.
Yes.
Yes
Yes.
Yes, good for me. Need to be back by the 22nd.
Budget $2,500 per person all in?
Fine.
Fine.
Sure.
Fine, ideally less.
Fine by me. Heading into a meeting, back tonight.
Patagonia flights are about $1,300 round trip. I checked earlier.
I just checked for Nov 14 to 21 specifically and I'm seeing $1,800 from SFO.
Then wait a week, they'll drop. They always drop.
Oh sure, because airfare famously only goes down.
Dolomites is around $900 into Venice, and there's a train to Cortina.
Fair, but the Dolomites huts are basically all closed by mid-November.
Oh great, $1,800 for flights. Budget's just a suggestion I guess.
Alex, hut opening dates vary. I'll check the actual dates tonight.
Priya's flight number can't be right, I saw $1,300.
Al, mine is for the exact dates. Yours may have been for another month.
Could be. Patagonia is still worth it.
Hut update. I went through the websites of the main rifugi around Cortina and Val Gardena. Most close between late October and about Nov 5.
So for Nov 14 to 21, hut to hut is basically off the table. Al was right about that.
Told you.
So it's just valley hiking in the Dolomites then? Day hikes from a base?
Yes, and that could be great. I think the cable cars in the valleys still run until early December.
Leo said he's fine with anything, so that's Leo covered.
Valley hiking is cheaper too, no hut fees.
J, are you on team Dolomites then?
Yeah, if it's cheaper. Dolomites.
JD, come on, you said either.
I said either, then Priya found the price difference.
Separate thing. I found a chalet in Ortisei. Six beds, $2,240 for the week, so about $373 each.
$373 is fine. Flights $900, chalet $373, food maybe $500. That's about $1,800, so there's room.
So Patagonia flights are $1,300 like Alex said and the Dolomites total is about $1,800.
Sam, I said $1,800 for the Patagonia flights. Alex's $1,300 was an older number.
She's right. Scratch my $1,300, that was a spring fare. $1,800 is right for these dates.
But Patagonia is still the better trip.
Ok, calling it. Vote. Patagonia or the Dolomites (valley-based)? One word please.
Dolomites.
Dolomites.
Dolomites.
Patagonia.
Dolomites from me too. That's 4 to 1, and Leo's fine with anything, so it's decided.
Fine. I'm not thrilled but fine.
Back to the chalet. It's free that week, but I think it'll be gone by Friday.
Looks great. I'm in on the chalet.
Chalet is fine cost-wise. I'd want to see the kitchen though, I'd cook to save money.
Leaning yes on the chalet. Alex?
I'll go wherever. Chalet's fine.
Rental cars? Two cars for the week is about $560 total, so about $93 each plus fuel.
Careful, I think Italy requires winter tires or chains from Nov 15. Our dates straddle that.
Rental companies include them, no?
Not sure. Probably costs extra.
We could also take the train from Venice to Bolzano and then a bus into the valley. Slower but cheap.
Let's not decide transport yet. Jordan, can you price cars including tires?
Yes.
I'll look at the train and bus times.
Catching up. Dolomites valley hiking? I thought we were doing huts?
The huts close before mid-Nov, Priya checked. So valley hiking from a chalet. Everyone's on board, and you said you're fine with anything.
I said I was flexible, not that I didn't care. I was really excited about the huts.
Sorry Leo, the huts really do close before our dates.
Ok. Then honestly I'd rather do Patagonia with the refugios, that's the hut experience.
Yes! Leo gets it. Patagonia.
Leo, we voted while you were away. It was 4 to 1 for the Dolomites. With you it's 4 to 2.
Fine, majority rules. I'll go along. Just wanted it noted.
Same here. I'll go along. Also noted.
Thanks both, I appreciate it.
Chalet's fine. Is it close to a cable car though? I'd want a couple of high days.
It's a short walk to the Seceda lift in Ortisei. I'll double check the November operating dates.
Great, so the chalet is Ortisei, six of us. Priya, can you book before Friday?
Not until everyone confirms. Alex, Maya, Jordan, Leo, can you each confirm the chalet?
Confirmed.
Confirmed, once I've seen the kitchen photos.
Confirmed.
Confirmed.
Sent the kitchen photos.
<Media omitted>
Kitchen is fine. Fully confirmed.
Ok, I'll book it tonight.
Recap: Dolomites, valley-based, Ortisei chalet, Nov 14 to 21, $2,500 cap. Transport still open. Right?
Right. I'll post car prices with tires by tomorrow.
I'll post train and bus times.
I'll check whether we need chains, unless Jordan finds out first.
I'll research day hike routes from Ortisei, Seceda and Alpe di Siusi at least.
I'll look at the November lift schedules.
Perfect. Thanks all.
Booked. Confirmation is in the app.
